scope: Frozen matched auxiliary binary-supervision experiment. Both arms retain six-class CE .2; only binary supervision on the exact same64 auxiliary windows differs, weight0 versus.2.
model_choice: Quiet-bound8bit export frozen by numeric/fidelity only, not detector scores.6bit grid failed prespecifiedcosinegate and is rejected.
frontend: Exact512FFT window and257x32melmatrix,160samplehop,80dBfloor per1760sample block;8newframes per1280PCM/80ms. Native host versus source graph verified training-only.
data: Existing source/voice partitions; training+validation only.2normal-speed TTS variants: original quiet and room/gain/noise augmentation. Same human/environment source partitions, only training for fitting; no reserved testing read.
labels: Positive whole-phrase end uses existing synthesis/RMS metadata. Random head end .03.. .32seconds after label; reportendpointuncertainty. Negatives sample across all source windows.
head: Flatten16x96 -> Dense64 -> LayerNorm(epsilon1e-5) -> ReLU -> Dense64 -> LayerNorm(epsilon1e-5) -> ReLU -> Dense1 sigmoid

event_policy.selection_order: Original strict validation policy, one fixed final checkpoint; no new temporal window or detector-side change.

upstream_match_scope: Same DNN topology and LayerNorm epsilon, adapted to Keras, with v1 fixed training recipe rather than claiming identical upstream optimization.

interface_fidelity_gate.scope: Historical pretraining interface-pilot evidence is not a current-model fidelity pass. Record each new export float/INT8 errors and require independent P4 numeric/resource evidence before production.

hypothesis: Does explicitly training the existing sigmoid on complete target/confuser auxiliary windows improve its low-false-event tradeoff beyond shared lexical representation training alone?
training_only_auxiliary: Dense6 softmax CE on the shared final64-unit ReLU, balanced class/engine separate64-example sampler. Auxiliary output is discarded at export. Main128-example BCE and loss weights are unchanged.
matched_comparison: Same original initialization,seed741,all10000 main/auxiliary batches,PTQ,schedule,CE .2,final10000step checkpoint and validation grid. Only auxiliary weighted BCE weight0 versus.2 differs. Auxiliary class0 remains positive; five exact confuser classes remain negative. Main binary labels and sampler remain unchanged.
decision_gate: Retain original strict calibration and entire fixed grid. Also report highest macro proxy-window hits at continuous_upper95<=.5/h and worst confusing-corpus false fraction<=.01, or null if no point. Advance only on a clear improvement at these fixed joint constraints; no physical/final scoring of inferior candidates.
limits: Existing energy/synthesis endpoints and synthetic voice partitions do not establish real-user recall or phonetic latency. Auxiliary source RMS is not phonetic truth. Goal requires later native event,hardware/resource/acoustic/voice stability and independent FAR validation.
auxiliary_binary_supervision: Reuse exact existing64 auxiliary histories; apply the original weighted BCE (negative weight5) to the existing sigmoid with labels class0->1,classes1..5->0. No new sampler, graph, feature inputs, class labels or audio.

control_replication.policy: Check exact control main/auxiliary batch and PTQ hashes and original exported control model bytes against v1 treatment. Preserve any failed replication; do not assume equivalence from topology.
